content.value_statement: Product naming often becomes a rushed list of options without clear strategy. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through discovery, naming routes, validation, and final selection.
actual_capabilities: Guides a six-step product naming workflow from discovery to final confirmation.
Extracts target users, product positioning, brand tone, naming constraints, and strategic tensions.
Creates two to four naming routes with sample names, advantages, and drawbacks.
Narrows a chosen route into three to five candidate names with clear explanations.
Supports competitor naming research before recommending language, slogan, and naming strategy.
Summarizes the decision chain behind the final product name.
limitations: It does not guarantee trademark, domain, or app store availability.
It needs user input about audience, positioning, tone, and naming constraints.
Competitor validation depends on available search access and current public information.
It focuses on naming strategy, not full visual identity or legal review.

use_cases.title: Name a New Startup Product
use_cases.description: Move from a rough product idea to naming routes, candidates, and a final naming strategy.

use_cases.title: Rename an Internal Tool
use_cases.description: Clarify users, boundaries, and tone before choosing a clearer project or module name.

use_cases.title: Validate Shortlisted Names
use_cases.description: Compare finalist names against competitor patterns and decide whether a slogan or local name is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Naming Session
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me name a new product. Start by asking about users, positioning, boundaries, tone, language, length, and words to avoid.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Naming Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product brief and extract naming constraints. Identify strategic tensions, priorities, and missing questions before suggesting any names.

prompt_templates.title: Create Naming Routes
prompt_templates.prompt: Based on our confirmed constraints, propose two to four naming routes. Include sample names, advantages, drawbacks, and a recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Finalists
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate these finalist names against competitor naming patterns. Recommend one final name, slogan needs, and the decision rationale.

output_examples.input: Name an async standup tool for remote developer teams.
output_examples.output: The skill first asks about users, tone, boundaries, and constraints. It then presents routes such as action words, rhythm metaphors, and coined names.

output_examples.input: We chose the rhythm metaphor route for a planning product.
output_examples.output: The skill develops three to five focused candidates, explains each name, and keeps the exploration within the selected direction.

output_examples.input: Compare our finalist name with products in the same category.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes competitor naming patterns, checks likely collision risk, and recommends a final naming strategy.

best_practices: Share the target users, main use case, brand tone, and words to avoid before asking for names.
Choose a naming route before requesting detailed candidate names.
Validate finalist names with competitor research and legal review before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a long name list before clarifying product positioning.
Do not choose a name only because it sounds pleasant.
Do not skip competitor, trademark, domain, and localization checks.

faq.question: Does this skill create names immediately?
faq.answer: No. It first clarifies the product, audience, constraints, and brand tone before suggesting names.

faq.question: Can it help with Chinese and English names?
faq.answer: Yes. It can discuss language strategy and whether one name, two names, or a slogan is appropriate.

faq.question: Does it check trademarks?
faq.answer: No. It can flag likely collision concerns, but trademark review needs a qualified legal process.

faq.question: How many naming routes does it provide?
faq.answer: It usually provides two to four routes so users can choose a strategic direction before detailed naming.

faq.question: Can it rename existing products?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide current positioning, user feedback, and reasons the current name no longer works.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
